name: vault
description: Zero-knowledge password manager - a client-custody consumer of the Sealed Vault. Passwords are encrypted and decrypted only in the browser; the server stores opaque ciphertext and never holds the key.
author: System Developer

settings.name: vault_autolock_minutes
settings.label: Auto-lock after (minutes)
settings.helptext: How long the password vault stays unlocked without activity.

settings.name: vault_clipboard_clear_seconds
settings.label: Clear clipboard after (seconds)
settings.helptext: A copied password is wiped from the clipboard after this long.
